generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Conditional tender will not be considered.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
Tender application amount will not be refundable.
The employer reserves the right to accept any tender and to reject any or all tenders without assigning any reason.
The contractor has to compete the bid (quote the rates excluding GST) for all schedule B items of the works mentioned.

The Contractor shall pay the Earnest Money Deposit EMD & Tender Transaction fee in the KPPP portal using any of the following payment modes: Credit Card, Direct Debit, National Electronic Fund Transfer, NEFT, and Over the Counter OTC.

The tenderer shall scan and upload all the original documents required for this bid to the KPPP portal. The uploaded documents should be clear (Visible), unclear documents will be rejected. The original documents shall be produced at the time of physical verification.
One percent of the bill amount of the successful tenderer will be deducted towards cess as a labor welfare fund.
Omission and typographical errors which are in the opinion of the executive Engineer will not be a ground for claims of extra payment.
Royalty charges will be deducted from the contractors as per prevailing Government order at the time of payment.
The tender is invited as per Standard tender Bid Document KW-4 and shall abide for the conditions contained in Standard tender Bid Document KW-4.

Executive engineer reserves the right to accept or reject any tender and to cancel the tender process and reject all tenders at any time prior to award of contract, without thereby incurring any liability to the affected tenderer or tenderers or any obligation to inform the affected tenderer or tenderers of the grounds for the employers action.
IT & GST will be deducted as per prevailing Government order.

Contractors have to upload the certificates of works in hand of any Department/Institutions failing which the tender will not be considered. Action will be taken as per clause 31 of Section2: INSTRUCTIONS TO TENDERERS (ITT) in case of incomplete/false documents regarding works in hand for calculation of tender capacity.

The contractor should obtain the Material Dispatch Permit for stone, aggregates, sand and Murrum etc will be used in the construction work from the Mines and Geology department at the time of execution and same should be submitted along with the workbill, then for such workbills no Royalty will be deducted. If the contractor failed to submit the Material Dispatch Permit along with the work bill Five times Royalty will be deducted from the work bill as per KMMCR 2016 amendment rule 44(4) and the circular vide No. C1/115/MNM-2019 Dated:30/06/2020 by Mines and Geology department
All documents to be furnished are to be counter signed by the employer in charge, not below the rank of an executive in-charge or equivalent.
Annual turnover certificate along with Balance sheet certificate/attested by Chartered accountants should be uploaded with 18-Digit system generated unique document identification number (UDIN).

Liquid assets and/or availability of credit facilities from banks for meeting the fund requirement should be submitted in the prescribed format as per the state government circular No. GO-FD-CAM/16/2022(P-2), Bangalore Dated:22-08-2022
The tenderer shall have valid Class-III and above Registration certificate.

Original documents shall be produced for verification at any stage of the Tender process, and when sought for. Failure to produce original documents will lead to disqualification. Necessary work experience certificate issued by the competent authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer, indecating the name/items of work executed, date of commencement, date of completion and the total cost of work executed shall be enclosed to the tenderer. Tenders without these details are liable for disqualification.

The statement showing the value of existing committements and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent shall be uploaded.

The contractor shall quote the rates without adding GST for either materials or the works contract (service). GST payable by the contractor under this works/ contract will be paid to the contractor over and above the contracts bid amount.

The tenderer has to quote his rate by EXCLUDING GST. However contract will be cocluded for tha amount (Exclusive of GST) but applicable GST will be paid separately as per the GST prevailing at the time of execution. If the GST rates are revised during the contract period, the Tenderer/ EMployer has to accept the revised GST rates for making payment/recovery.
GST, MDP and other deductions will be done as per the prevailing Government Orders.
Bidder shall ensure upload of relevent documents as prescribed in the tender document.
Price Adjustment and star rates are not applicable as per the prevailing G.O No: PWD/159 CRM dt 30.9.2010

itemList.description: Cutting and removing jauliflora bushes upto 1.50 m girth excluding removal of stumps and including burning or disposing off the materials as directed with all other ancillary operations. complete with all lead and lift as directed by Engineer in charge.

Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the work etc., In all kinds of soils Depth upto 3 m. (0 to 3.0m) complete with all lead and lifts and as directed by Engineer in Charge.

Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the work, In ordinary/soft rock without blasting upto 1.5 m depth. (0 to 1.5m) complete with all lead and lifts and as directed by Engineer in Charge.

Providing rubble stone/boulder filling between or behind abutment below apron including cost of all materials, labour, hand packing, finishing top surface & all necessary works as directed and complete with all lead and lifts as directed by Engineer in charge.

Providing and laying in-situ vibrated M-15 grade cement concrete using 40 mm down Approved, clean, hard, graded aggregates for plain concrete works including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, providing mortar layer for lift joints, batching, mixing, placing in position, levelling, vibrating, finishing, curing with all other ancillary operations complete etc., complete with all lead and lifts and as directed by Engineer in Charge.

Providing and laying insitu vibrated M-20 ( 28 days cube compressive strength not less than 20 N / sq mm ) grade cement concrete using 20mm down size approved, clean, hard, graded aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, including cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, centering, formwork and scafolding and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications for check dam /pickups /irrigation tanks/waste weir/sluice, sluice canal and other allied works like abutments/wing walls/returns/cutoff walls works & all necessary works as directed and complete as per specification etc., complete with all lead and lifts and as directed by Engineer in Charge.

Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification -All other works., complete with all lead and lifts and as directed by Engineer in Charge.

Providing impervious filling adjacent to masonry / concrete structure and filling trial pits with soil available in adjacent area in layers of 100 to 150 mm and compacting each layer to density control of not less than 95 percent using pneumatic tampers or by vibratory earth rammers including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, picking previous layer, spreading soil in layer, breaking clods, watering & all necessary works as directed and complete with all lead and lifts as directed by Engineer in charge.

De-silting of Feeder Channel/Canal in dry condition by excavating the deposited bed material and loading the same to transport vehicle ( excluding cost of transportation ) including cost of all machinery, labour & all necessary works as directed and complete with all lead and lifts as directed by Engineer in charge.

itemList.description: Compacting original ground supporting embankment - Loosening, leveling and Compacting original ground supporting embankment to facilitate placement of first layer of embankment, scarified to a depth of 150 mm, mixed with water at OMC and then compacted by rolling so as to achieve minimum dry density as given in Table 300-2 for embankment construction. complete with all lead and lifts as directed by Engineer in charge.

Providing new embankment abutting to existing bund to strength the existing bund using soil from approved borrow area in layers of 200 to 250 mm and compacting each layer to density control of not less than 95 percent by vibrating plate compactor or pnuematic tamper including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, picking previous layer, spreading soil in layer, breaking clods, watering & all necessary works as directed and complete with all lead and lifts as directed by Engineer in charge.

Providing and constructing dry rubble stone pitching with pin headers at 2 per m2 using stones and stone chips from approved source including cost of all materials, labour, hand packing / wedging stone chips, finishing and all other ancillary operations complete. 300mm thick. complete with all lead and lift as directed by Engineer in charge.

Providing and constructing 450 mm thick hand packed rough stone revetment consisting of 300 mm thick rough stones with 400 to 450 mm long through stones at 1.5 m c / c over a backing of 150 mm thick 40 mm down graded coarse aggregate layer including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, laying to specified slope, wedging with chips, finishing etc., complete with all lead and lift as directed by Engineer in charge.
